page.overview:
Who is Adine Canford?

Adine Canford is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

Adine is a plump Andoran with blue eyes and short black hair.

Adine is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing. Moiraine describes her as "not very strong in the Power".

Adine is 95 years old. She was born in and she went to the White Tower in 920 NE. After spending twelve years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
